record.original_question: Does there exist a Banach space X such that K(X) is a semi M-ideal in L(X) without being an M-ideal in L(X)?

evidence.quote: Definition 11.4. (˚A. Lima, 1977, see [2]) The subspace Y is a semi M-ideal in X if whenever g ∈ X∗ is such that kg|Y k = kgk, and h ∈ Y⊥, then kg + hk = kgk + khk.
Problem 11.6. Does there exist a Banach space X such that K(X) is a semi M-ideal in L(X) without being an M-ideal in L(X)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a Banach space. Denote by L(X) the Banach space of bounded linear operators on X (with the operator norm) and by K(X) its closed subspace of compact operators. For a closed subspace Y of a Banach space Z, write Y^⊥ = { g ∈ Z* : g|_Y = 0 } for its annihilator in the dual Z*.

Say that Y is a semi M-ideal in Z if for every g ∈ Z* with ‖g|_Y‖ = ‖g‖ and every h ∈ Y^⊥ one has
   ‖g + h‖ = ‖g‖ + ‖h‖.

Say that Y is an M-ideal in Z if Z* admits an ℓ_1-direct sum decomposition Z* = Y^⊥ ⊕_1 V for some closed subspace V ⊂ Z* (equivalently, every g ∈ Z* decomposes uniquely as g = v + h with v ∈ V, h ∈ Y^⊥, and ‖g‖ = ‖v‖ + ‖h‖). Every M-ideal is a semi M-ideal.

Question: Does there exist a Banach space X such that K(X) is a semi M-ideal in L(X) but K(X) is not an M-ideal in L(X)?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on semi M-ideals of compact operators in L(X) did not return any source explicitly resolving (positively or negatively) the existence of a Banach space X for which K(X) is a semi M-ideal but not an M-ideal in L(X). Standard references on M-ideal theory (e.g., Harmand–Werner–Werner) and recent work on M-ideals of compact operators do not appear to settle this specific question, so the status is unclear from the available search results.

status_evidence.title: M-Ideals in Banach Spaces and Banach Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Standard reference on M-ideal theory in Banach spaces; treats M-ideals of compact operators but the specific semi-M-ideal vs. M-ideal question for K(X) in L(X) is not stated as resolved.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit resolution of the semi M-ideal vs. M-ideal question for K(X) ⊂ L(X) is reported here.

status_evidence.title: M-ideals of compact operators and Norm attaining operators (arXiv:2402.12070)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on M-ideal properties of K(X,Y); does not address the existence of a semi M-ideal example that fails to be an M-ideal.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature on M-ideals of compact operators does not appear to resolve the question.
